fact_text: Mari's main gas field has been producing gas since 1960, and output has grown over the decades.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Most of Pakistan's large fertilizer plants take their gas from Mari's field, which the analyst sees as a reliable, long-running supply relationship.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Mari holds 100% ownership of three exploration blocks close to Chagai district (EL 186, 322 and 323), where exploration work has already started.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Mari holds about a 55% stake in the Waziristan block, where four discoveries, including Shewa and Spinbam, have been announced.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Mari participates in Abu Dhabi Block 6 alongside OGDC, PPL and another state-owned company.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst gives three reasons for Mari's long compounding record: a superior field where drilling finds gas, superior customers who pay on time, and a tiered gas pricing policy.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst describes Mari's earnings as dollar-linked, so movements in oil and gas prices feed directly into them.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Mari's annual profit rose from about PKR 4 billion in 2014 to about PKR 77 billion in 2024, while its gas output rose only about 50-60% over the same period.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst argues Mari's profit growth between 2014 and 2024 came mainly from better pricing on incremental gas rather than from volume, so pricing structure matters more than output.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Under the 2013-2014 tiered gas policy, the analyst says each extra unit from an old field earns about six times the after-tax profit of base volume.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The royalty rate on Mari's older field was raised from 12.5% to 27.5% in FY26.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst estimates Mari's annual operating costs at roughly PKR 25-30 billion around FY26.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst estimates Mari's FY26 revenue at roughly PKR 155-175 billion, with the range driven by volatile oil prices and tariff-related uncertainty.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst excludes exploration expense from Mari's real earnings because accounting treats it as an expense, while economically it is an investment in the business.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Because Mari's main buyers are fertilizer makers that pay on time, and gas is sold largely for cash, the company has avoided the circular-debt problem seen elsewhere in the energy chain.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Security incidents in the Waziristan area can delay production there, and the analyst notes that markets price in future output before it starts flowing.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Once Waziristan production starts, the block could contribute a meaningful share of Mari's new earnings, so the security situation there is a key item to track.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Mari's planned gold and copper mining projects would take years from exploration to earnings, possibly five to ten years, although markets tend to price them in early.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst cites Mari's historical fair P/E range as roughly 10 to 14 times earnings, and says investors pay above that range only for high-return businesses.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Mari's field has a well success rate of roughly 60-70%, against about 35% for a typical Pakistani field, which lowers the drilling cost per unit of gas found.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Mari's field gas is found at roughly 1,000 metres depth, versus about 3,000 metres for a typical Pakistani discovery, which keeps drilling costs down.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst says Mari's field operating cost is roughly half that of other Pakistani gas fields, a structural advantage rather than a cyclical one.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A gas producer with a long reserve life only needs to drill as much as it produces, so exploration spend roughly matches output to keep reserves steady.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst values growth stocks by projecting earnings five to six years ahead, applying the P/E he expects then, and comparing that future value with today's price.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A high P/E can only be justified by a high return on invested capital, because only then do profits compound fast enough to pay back a premium price.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Land-based drilling in Pakistan is relatively cheap because wells are not very deep and labour costs are low, which makes oil and gas exploration here a high-return business.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan is a net oil and gas deficit country, so domestic discoveries are valuable, and oil and gas prices are set in dollar terms.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: During the 2013-2014 gas and power shortage, Pakistan introduced a policy paying higher prices for incremental output from local gas fields than for base output.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst argues that local gas, even at premium incremental prices, is cheaper than imported LNG, which makes paying more for extra local gas economically sensible.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI ENERGIES - everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)
